name: timer
author: Presio
description: A talk timer on your dashboard, counting up or down, with a warning as time runs out. Only you see it.

commands.title: Start or stop the talk timer

buttons.tooltip: Start or stop the talk timer

mode.description: Count the talk up from zero, or down from the countdown length.

durationMinutes.description: Countdown length in minutes (2.5 is 2:30), when counting down.

warningMinutes.description: Turn the timer red at this many minutes: remaining when counting down, elapsed when counting up. Leave empty for no warning.

showClock.description: Also show the current time on the card.
